statements.status_notes: In nspawn in systemd 233 through 259 before 260, an escape-to-host action can occur via a crafted optional config file.
statements.impact_statement: The flaw is in systemd-nspawn, the systemd container manager: a crafted optional .nspawn settings file can let a container escape to the host. Exploitation requires the host to launch containers with systemd-nspawn. In Ubuntu, systemd-nspawn ships in the separate systemd-container binary package; libsystemd0 and libudev1 ship one client library each (libsystemd.so.0 and libudev.so.1) and contain no nspawn code. The Liquibase Secure image build installs no systemd packages of its own (it adds only unzip, removed again after use), the container has no init system, and PID 1 is the Liquibase entrypoint script, which runs the Liquibase CLI and never invokes systemd-nspawn or any systemd service. Ubuntu fixed the issue in 249.11-0ubuntu3.21 (jammy) and 255.4-1ubuntu8.16 (noble). Docker images 5.0.0 and 5.0.1 (jammy, 249.11-0ubuntu3.16) and 5.0.2 through 5.2.0 (noble, 255.4-1ubuntu8.11 to 8.15) carry unfixed builds; 5.2.1 carries 255.4-1ubuntu8.16 and 5.2.2 and 6.0.0 carry 255.4-1ubuntu8.17.

statements.status_notes: systemd-journald can send ANSI escape sequences to the terminals of arbitrary users when a "logger -p emerg" command is executed, if ForwardToWall=yes is set. ForwardToWall defaults to yes.
statements.impact_statement: The flaw is in the systemd-journald daemon: with ForwardToWall enabled (the default), a "logger -p emerg" message is forwarded to user terminals without stripping escape sequences. The forwarding path exists in systemd 255.4, the version Ubuntu noble ships, and no upstream fix exists. The Liquibase Secure container never runs it: the systemd, systemd-sysv and udev packages are not installed, no systemd-journald binary exists in the image, there is no init system and PID 1 is the Liquibase entrypoint script. libsystemd0 and libudev1 ship one client library each (libsystemd.so.0 and libudev.so.1), pulled in by util-linux and apt, and contain no journald code.
